inAppPurchases.reviewNote: Founding Supporter is a one-time purchase that unlocks only looks: the OLED Black, Midnight, Ember and Dusk themes, seven accent colors, four chat fonts, eleven iPhone icons, and a flame badge in the buyer's color beside their name in chat, with their name in that color or glowing and a founding number, which other Embr viewers see. Every look can be tried on before buying. Find it in Settings > Become a Founding Supporter on iPhone and iPad. Watching and chat never need it.
